title: Add index on Orders.CustomerId
body:
**Server:** sql-prod-01
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Index

**What and why:** The customer order history page scans dbo.Orders. An index on CustomerId should fix it.

**Rollback plan:** DROP INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerId ON dbo.Orders;

title: Grant read access to the reporting team
body:
**Server:** sql-prod-01
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Permissions

**What and why:** The reporting team needs SELECT on dbo.Orders and dbo.Customers for the monthly sales report.

**Rollback plan:** REVOKE the grants from the Reporting role.

title: Fix duplicate customer emails
body:
**Server:** sql-prod-01
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Data fix

**What and why:** Three customers share an email after a bad import. Merge them and add a unique constraint.

**Rollback plan:** Restore the affected rows from the backup table made before the fix.

title: Archive cancelled orders older than a year
body:
**Server:** sql-prod-02
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Data fix

**What and why:** Move old cancelled orders to an archive table to keep dbo.Orders small.

**Rollback plan:** Move the rows back from dbo.OrdersArchive.

title: Add CreatedBy column to Orders
body:
**Server:** sql-dev-01
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Schema

**What and why:** Support wants to know who entered each order. Add a nullable CreatedBy column.

**Rollback plan:** ALTER TABLE dbo.Orders DROP COLUMN CreatedBy;

title: Rebuild fragmented indexes on Customers
body:
**Server:** sql-prod-02
**Database:** DemoShop
**Type of change:** Index

**What and why:** Index fragmentation on dbo.Customers is over 60 percent. Rebuild during the weekend window.

**Rollback plan:** None needed. A rebuild doesn't change data.
